build.buildCommand: corepack enable && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --filter @timeline/db build && pnpm --filter @timeline/shared build && pnpm --filter @timeline/web build

preDeployCommand: sh -lc 'test -f scripts/env-reset.ts && test -f packages/db/drizzle/meta/_journal.json && pnpm exec tsx --version && node packages/db/dist/migrate.js'
